summary: Revised implementation plan incorporating the scoped .light-high-contrast theme architecture in src/index.css. This ensures that dark mode (.dark) remains authentic without being overridden, while light mode (.light-high-contrast) applies the clean enterprise slate palette with deep charcoal text and royal blue accents. Covers seamless floating toggle operation, 4-step wizard refinement, explicit dual-location Aria sizing controls, Nutanix NC2 on Azure integration, verified 9-stage migration runbooks, and an automated Vitest calculation test suite.
